scope: Standalone bounded observer only: caller-supplied bytes and typed model are not reader-origin capabilities; no graph closure, output authorization, text/codepage semantics or general XRECORD conformance is asserted.

evidence.source: ODA File Converter 27.1.0 AC1018 conversion of locally generated ezdxf table; source SHA256 1ba45d704ed7cc846ea4d6d08c7c78062f8090842ebc9e9a4cdefcb44ea6ab2a
evidence.spec: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 sections 20.4.97, 20.1 and 2.13. Spec describes XRECORD strings with RC length; the observed producer-specific source uses RS length and this observer only accepts the latter. Byte 45 does not establish codepage semantics.

profile.object: AC1018 fixed XRECORD type 79, no EED or extension dictionary, one reactor, cloning 1; bounded source frame at most 4096 bytes.
profile.payload: 89 bytes, exactly ordered group/value pairs: 102=ACAD_ROUNDTRIP_PRE2007_TABLESTYLE; 90=4; 91=0; 1=empty; 92=4; 93=0; 2=empty; 94=4; 95=0; 3=empty. All four strings use observed RS length and page byte 45; values compared as bytes, not decoded semantics.
profile.links: Owner H4 and reactor H4 must be the same nonzero non-sentinel handle, distinct from self, and agree with typed and validated raw metadata. Numeric handles may vary. Raw data end, exact payload/handles and zero padding are checked.
profile.typed: Ordered m_dataEntries are authoritative. Legacy m_values/m_handleValues may differ and are not consulted. Raw bytes and typed fields are compared; private source identity is not authenticated.
profile.source_spans: Physical payload [81,793), data end 803; owner [803,819), reactor [819,835), remaining padding zero. Generated writer independently records every group and handle span.
